problem_statement: The DAC driver devicetree API is missing the DT-spec helper capability that the ADC API already has. Applications need to describe a DAC output channel in devicetree via an io-channels specifier with an 'output' cell, and to extract that channel information into a struct dac_dt_spec for use by helper APIs (channel setup, value write, ready check). The new devicetree macros DT_IO_CHANNELS_OUTPUT_BY_IDX/BY_NAME and their INST variants, together with DAC_DT_SPEC_GET_BY_NAME/GET_BY_IDX (and the _OR fallback variants) and DAC_DT_SPEC_INST_* variants, must resolve the channel id and controller node from a node with an io-channels property. A DAC channel referenced as io-channels = <&dac 10>, <&dac 20> with io-channel-names "ch1","ch2" must yield channel id 10 for the first element (by index 0, by name ch1) and 20 for the second, with the _OR variants falling back to the supplied default when the name, index, or node is absent.
